Speed/steering precedence, carrier/berth/tow/recovery, successful exits, inventory/knowledge and schema/journals are preserved. Short result only when matching visible current guidance supplies the complete actionable reason; changes clear obsolete results, same-depth updates remain accurate and unmatched results retain full fallback. Opening/missing actors/command batches/panels preserve semantics. Full accessible announcement once per attempt, including repeat attempts; no render replay. Success says Left the craft without false air claim.
6. **Concise composed UI:** requested title/pause/habitat/fabrication/save copy and actual caption visibility work at CSS960×600/1280×800. Preserve full warnings/errors/accessibility/story/notebook/recovery guidance, semantic focus/storage intent and seven-warning layout. 7. **Checks, ownership and evidence integrity:** scoped source changes, meaningful regressions, clean test-only reconciliation, final419/typecheck/build/economies and matching build identity. Verify selected raw evidence/executable behavior independently rather than quoting only summaries. Retain diagnostic versus actual workflow provenance, failures and limits. Scope is both leaves, not merely the last diff.
